answer: Unique scarce-resource escrow: each identity must hold a distinct hardware-rooted radio beacon whose signal is verified against a registered physical location, like a sparrow tied to one nest. A sonnet-length challenge broadcast must be answered within microseconds from that fixed position, proving co-location no remote operator can clone. An oasis of unclaimed spectrum per region caps registrations. Faking one identity costs a physical device plus a licensed site lease — thousands of dollars and weeks of setup per node, making mass fabrication economically irrational.
